component.name: SpritX
component.summary: A GPU-accelerated terminal with built-in remote control

description.p: SpritX is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator for the desktop. It has tabs and split panes, parses OSC 133 shell-integration markers into command blocks with exit codes and timings, keeps a searchable command history, and shows a file tree with git status next to the terminal.

Its remote control is built in and end-to-end encrypted: pair a phone or a second machine and drive the same panes from there, over the LAN or a Cloudflare quick tunnel. The browser client needs no installation, and paired devices can be revoked at any time.
First packaged release: Flatpak, AppImage, deb, rpm and an Arch package.
